messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary cohort 'canary-eu-west-1' failing health checks (service: serving-runtime). 5xx spike: 12% over baseline for last 3m. Auto-escalation threshold hit. PagerDuty: P1 triggered.

maya: seeing it on the dashboard too — canary traffic at ~6% of prod, but error rate is way up. frontends reporting 502/503.

sam: rolling out v2a ~10m ago. Can't see obvious config drift. anyone able to check logs for oom/quantization errors?

leo: logs show repeated 'kv cache mismatch' + 'out_of_memory' in worker-gpu-3. OOMs only at higher seq lengths. Could be model variant.

tess: runbook says: if canary 5xx > 10% for 3m -> Flip kill-switch and abort rollout. We should flip before customers see widespread impact. I'll prepare the flag command.

maya: agreed. @sam can you prepare rollback plan in case flag flip doesn't fix it? Also @leo can you try to tail a failing allocation?

sam: rollback plan: revert to model v2 (previous) on canary nodes, then scale down v2a. Command: ```redwoodctl rollout abort --target canary-eu-west-1 --reason "v2a 5xx spike"``` If flag flip fails we'll run that.

oncall-bot: Action needed: approve emergency toggle for feature.flag.canary_v2a -> current state: enabled. Approver list: maya, sam.

maya: I'm approving and flipping now. Doing: ```curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/flags/feature.flag.canary_v2a/toggle -d '{"enabled":false,"actor":"maya"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'``` I'll post the response.

oncall-bot: FLAG UPDATE: feature.flag.canary_v2a set to false by maya at 3890123472. Propagation to edge-control plane starting.

leo: tailing worker logs during propagation: errors dropping already on node-7. 5xx in last minute down to ~4%.

sam: checking client-side metrics and SLO dashboards: 5xx across canary cohort down to 0.8% in the last 2m. Latencies returning to normal. Good.

maya: customer impact: preliminary list: alpha-enterprises (non-prod traffic), beta-retail (small percent of prod routed through canary) — both reported elevated errors via support tickets. No major revenue-impacting customers affected so far. I'll loop in customer-success for outreach.

tess: opening an incident ticket for postmortem and followups. Next steps: collect traces for failing requests, capture model artifact differences (v2 vs v2a), reproduce in staging with seq>2048, and review canary gating thresholds.

sam: I will kick off reproducible run with same traffic profile. If we confirm kv cache mismatch under quantized path, patch may be needed in runtime.

maya: handing off to @sam for monitoring the rollback/recovery. I'll remain on-call for 30 more minutes in case propagation issues surface. If you need me escalate to eng-runtime, ping me.

oncall-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged by maya/sam/leo/tess. Status: mitigation completed (kill-switch flip). Monitoring for 30m.

leo: quick note: collect the worker core dumps from node-gpu-3 and node-gpu-7 before they rotate logs. I already copied them to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/3890123456.

maya: thanks all. we'll sync in an incident postmortem tomorrow. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml. :handshake:
